support_role: Facts establish reported CPI levels and prior official comparison; they do not establish the expectation response.
assumptions: Investors interpret the headline decrease relative to their prior information as policy-relevant; their actual prior expectations are unavailable.
falsifiers: Dated policy-rate expectations do not move in the posited direction or move mainly on concurrent information.
watch: Time-stamped Treasury yields, policy-rate futures and policy communication.

support_role: CPI facts provide event context only; no source directly verifies a technology-sector valuation effect.
assumptions: A material rate-expectation change passes through to valuation and is not dominated by earnings or risk-premium news.
falsifiers: Sector prices or discount-rate inputs do not align after controlling for contemporaneous announcements.
watch: Dated Treasury yields, sector returns and concurrent issuer disclosures.
